meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year passes through three stages: the budget estimate (February before the year), the revised estimate (February of the year) and the accounts (provisional in May after the year, audited later). The RBI's tables restate a year as it moves from one stage to the next; each stage is kept as its own series.
meta.coverage: Small savings scheme by scheme, financial year by financial year since 1970-71: money put in and outstanding at the end of March
meta.note: RBI, Small Savings (DBIE report 581, provider DP6; Handbook report 231, Bulletin report 62). Receipts are gross to 2016-17 and net of withdrawals from 2017-18: two series, never joined.
